bullets.section: Book that I couldn’t put down
bullets.title: Saga: Compendium One
bullets.note: This is a raucous masterpiece! After two close friends recommended it within 48 hours, I bit the bullet. I haven’t read graphic novels in ages, but this NSFW gem blew me away. I tore through it in two days. It’s rare that both the writing and artwork grab me, but this did it. Deep bow and “More please!” to [Brian K. Vaughan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brian_K._Vaughan) ([@briankvaughan](https://www.instagram.com/briankvaughan/)), [Fiona Staples](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiona_Staples) ([@fionastaples](https://www.instagram.com/fionastaples/)), and [FONOGRAFIKS](https://imagecomics.com/creators/fonografiks). Don’t let the page count scare you, as it moves quickly with the artwork. Think of it as a 150–175-page book.
